    Animation - Class in com.animationlib.api

    A parsed animation: its loop flag, length in seconds, and per-bone keyframe channels.

    AnimationLoader - Class in com.animationlib.impl
    Loads animations from assets/<namespace>/animationlib/animations/ on every resource reload: Blockbench/Bedrock-format .json, and glTF 2.0 .gltf/.glb (see GltfLoader).
    AnimationPlayer - Class in com.animationlib.api
    Plays a loaded animation on an entity.
    AnimationPlayerImpl - Class in com.animationlib.impl
    Tracks which animation each entity is currently playing, keyed by entity id.
    AnimationPlayerImpl.Sample - Record Class in com.animationlib.impl
     
    AnimationRegistry - Class in com.animationlib.api
    Read-only access to animations loaded from assets/<namespace>/animationlib/animations/, populated automatically on resource reload.
    audioTrack(String, Player) - Method in class com.animationlib.api.Animation
    Plays soundId once at player's position each time this animation starts.

    Like Animation.cameraFollowsPlayer(String), but aims the camera at bone of some other entity entirely, which doesn't need to be the one this animation is played on.
    cameraFollowsPlayer(String) - Method in class com.animationlib.api.Animation
    While this animation plays, locks the camera onto bone of the entity it's being played on, instead of onto this animation's own camera bone, if any.
